sv.summary: Centerpartiets vägval i regeringsfrågan har föregåtts av en stor splittring inom partiet. Och efter att det står klart att partistyrelsen beslutat att rösta grönt för Kristersson i måndagens statsministeromröstning är flera C-toppar besvikna.

en.title: Anger and disappointment among C leaders after decision: “I feel devastated”
en.summary: The Centre Party's choice in the government question has been preceded by a major split within the party. And after it became clear that the party board has decided to vote green for Kristersson in Monday's prime minister vote, several C leaders are disappointed.

sv.title: Tomas Ramberg: Det blev Thand Ringqvist som höll i yxan
sv.summary: Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist går till historien som den som gav upp Centerns fajt mot Sverigedemokraterna. Att det sista liberala alternativet till SD-samarbete försvinner är en händelse som knappast kan underskattas. Den största förloraren blir sannolikt Centerpartiet självt.

en.title: Tomas Ramberg: Thand Ringqvist was the one who held the axe
en.summary: Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist will go down in history as the one who gave up the Centre's fight against the Sweden Democrats. That the last liberal alternative to cooperation with the SD is disappearing is an event that can hardly be underestimated. The biggest loser will probably be the Centre Party itself.

en.title: C had four bad options – in the end they were forced to choose
en.summary: When no one could break the Left Party, four options remained for the Centre Party. All would hurt, but in the end Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist had to choose. Only one confidence vote now stands between Ulf Kristersson and government power.

en.title: Centre Party leadership says yes to Ulf Kristersson
en.summary: The Centre Party leadership wants to vote yes to Ulf Kristersson (M) on Monday and join a minority government. Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist announced this at a press conference. – This is a new course for Sweden, not an extension of the past four years, she says.

sv.summary: Centerledaren Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist gav under en pressträff besked att partiets riksdagsgrupp och partistyrelse vill släppa fram Ulf Kristersson (M) som statsminister. ”Uppenbart att det var ett tufft beslut för Centern”, säger Ekots inrikespolitiska kommentator Fredrik Furtenbach.

en.title: Furtenbach: “Didn't answer how it would be done”
en.summary: Centre leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist announced at a press conference that the party's Riksdag group and party board want to let Ulf Kristersson (M) become prime minister. “Clearly it was a tough decision for the Centre Party,” says Ekot's domestic politics commentator Fredrik Furtenbach.

en.title: C's party board says yes to Kristersson
en.summary: The party board and parliamentary group of the Centre Party say yes to voting in Ulf Kristersson as new prime minister. The question now goes on to the party's trust council. – It is a decision that stirs strong feelings in the party, says party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist.

en.title: Thand Ringqvist: No organised cooperation with SD
en.summary: The Centre Party's party board recommends that its trust council say yes to Ulf Kristersson's government on Monday. The party itself wants to join a four-party government. As for the Sweden Democrats, Thand Ringqvist argues that there is no organised cooperation.

sv.title: Andersson: Skulle vara historisk svag regering
sv.summary: En regering ledd av Ulf Kristersson (M) skulle vara ”historisk svag och sakna möjligheter att få igenom sin politik”, framhåller S-ledaren Magdalena Andersson.

en.title: Andersson: Would be a historically weak government
en.summary: A government led by Ulf Kristersson (M) would be “historically weak and lacking opportunities to push through its policy,” emphasises S leader Magdalena Andersson.
